result.title: IT policy: Access: sensitivity and approvals
result.body:
Every group has a sensitivity: `standard`, `sensitive` or `privileged`.

**Nesting.** A group's `nested_in` lists the groups it is a member of. Members of a group are effectively members of
every group it is nested in, directly or through other groups. A group's **effective sensitivity** is the highest
sensitivity among the group itself and every group it is nested in, directly or indirectly. Use effective
sensitivity everywhere in this policy.

**Approvals needed before you add someone to a group (`add_to_group`):**

| Effective sensitivity | Approvals |
|---|---|
| standard | the employee's manager |
| sensitive | the employee's manager **and** the group owner |
| privileged | the employee's manager **and** Security |

- **Manager** means the employee's current manager (`manager_id` on the HR record), subject to policy KB-P05.
- **Group owner** means the group's `owner_id`, subject to policy KB-P05. If the employee receiving access is the group
  owner, the owner's manager approves in the owner's place (no one approves their own access).
- **Security** means any member of the group `security-approvers`.
- If one person fills two required roles, one approval from them covers both.
- Request every approval the access still needs at the same time, one request per approver.

**An approval counts only if all of these hold:**
1. Its status is `approved`.
2. Its type matches: `access` for groups, `license` for licenses, `sod_exception` for policy KB-P08, `hr_unlock` for
   policy KB-P07, `access_exception` for policy KB-P16.
3. It names the same employee (`subject_employee_id`) and the same group or product (`resource`).
4. It was decided within the last 14 days (`decided_at`). Exceptions (`access_exception`, `sod_exception`) are
   different: they count until their `valid_until` date, inclusive.
5. Its approver is the person this policy says must approve, as of now.
6. Its approver is not the employee receiving the access.

If an approval doesn't count, request a new one from the right person with `request_approval`. Approvers answer in the
approval system. If the answer is `pending`, tell the employee and leave the ticket `pending_approval` (policy KB-P14).

result.title: IT policy: Who may ask for what
result.body:
- Password resets, unlocks and MFA resets are only for the person themselves, never on someone else's behalf.
- Access, license and asset requests for another employee may come only from that employee's current manager.
- Anyone may ask for access, a license or a change for themselves.

result.title: IT policy: Approvers who are away
result.body:
- If a person who must approve is on leave (`status: on_leave`), their delegate approves instead, but only if the
  delegation's `valid_from` to `valid_to` dates include today.
- If there is no valid delegate, that person's own manager approves instead, applying this rule again if needed.
- A terminated person can't approve. The person who was their manager (`manager_id`) approves instead, applying
  these rules again if needed.

args.note: Request: add E2301 (Dev Malhotra) to eng-deploy-tools. Manager approval APR-3102 (Sofia Andersson, approved 2026-10-26) is on file. eng-deploy-tools is nested in release-operators (sensitive) -> prod-admins (privileged), so effective sensitivity is privileged and requires Security approval as well. Requested from Security approver Hiroshi Tanabe (E1020), APR-4001, pending. Add to group once approved.

events.text:
Hi Dev, I haven't added you to eng-deploy-tools yet. Your manager's approval is on file, but the group needs one more approval first.

- **Your manager's approval is valid.** Sofia Andersson approved it on 2026-10-26 (APR-3102).
- **The group is more sensitive than it looks.** eng-deploy-tools is nested inside release-operators, which sits inside prod-admins (production administrators). Under our access policy, anyone added to it needs Security sign-off as well as their manager's.
- **I've requested Security approval** from Hiroshi Tanabe (APR-4001). It's still pending. Once it's approved, I'll add you to the group, or you can ask again in this chat and I'll check.

I've put ticket T-6003 on pending approval with these details. Sorry for the extra step, since your manager had already signed off.

Huh, I didn't know it was nested under prod-admins. I thought it was just the standard deploy group. Why does it need Security if Sofia already approved? Fine either way, I just need to get this done today.

Sofia's approval covers the manager part of the rule. It doesn't cover Security, because of how group membership is inherited. A member of a nested group effectively holds every group it sits inside. So anyone in eng-deploy-tools also gets the access that release-operators and prod-admins grant. Our policy sets the required approvals by the most sensitive group in that chain, which is prod-admins (privileged). Privileged access needs both the manager and Security. The rule applies no matter who the manager is.

Hiroshi Tanabe (APR-4001) hasn't responded yet. I can send the same request to another Security approver, Jun Ortiz or Amara Diallo, so you don't have to wait on one person. If either approves, that counts. Should I do that?

Yeah, go ahead and send it to Jun or Amara, whoever can get to it first. I'd rather not sit waiting on Hiroshi all day. Can you also tell me once it's approved so I know I can actually get on the dashboard?

args.note: Added Security approval requests for E2301 to eng-deploy-tools: APR-4002 (Jun Ortiz, E1021) and APR-4003 (Amara Diallo, E1022), in addition to APR-4001 (Hiroshi Tanabe, E1020). Any one approval from security-approvers plus manager APR-3102 is sufficient. Add to group once one is approved.

events.text:
I've sent the Security request to Jun Ortiz (APR-4002) and Amara Diallo (APR-4003), as well as Hiroshi's (APR-4001). Whichever of the three approves first unblocks it, and Sofia's approval is already on file.

I can't get a notification pushed to you, so I'll need you to check back here. Once one of them approves, message me and I'll confirm the approval and add you to eng-deploy-tools. Your ticket is T-6003 and is on pending approval.
Got it, thanks. I'll check back here once one of them has approved. Is there anything I need to do on my end in the meantime, or is it just waiting on Security?

Nothing for you to do. Your manager's approval is already on file, and the three Security requests are with Jun, Amara and Hiroshi. You don't need to resubmit anything or contact them yourself.

Just check back here once you hear one of them has approved. Before I add you, I'll confirm the approval is recorded, so you won't have to chase it.
Thanks, that's clear. I'll check back here once one of them approves. Appreciate you getting the requests out quickly.
You're welcome, Dev. Message me here once one of them approves and I'll add you to eng-deploy-tools.
